'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Vikram Bali LS Don't Tread On Me!''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Vikram Bali]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Don't Tread On Me|Don't Tread On Me!]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
